Hi, I’m Pratistha Regmi! I’m a Business Analytics master’s student at Baruch College, and I enjoy finding the story behind the numbers. My background in business and event operations taught me to ask practical questions; now I’m learning how to answer them with data. This site is where I’ll share my STA 9750 projects, what I discover along the way, and a little of my personality too.

## My current reading mood 📚

I’m currently on the third book in the ACOTAR series, so fantasy and romance are definitely leading my reading mood right now, with a little mystery to keep things interesting! The chart below shows my personal rating for each genre out of 10.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Personal enjoyment ratings: fantasy nine, romance eight, and mystery seven out of ten."

reading_ratings <- c(
  "Fantasy" = 5,
  "Romance" = 10,
  "Mystery" = 9
)

bar_positions <- barplot(
  reading_ratings,
  col = c("#9381B5", "#E8A0BF", "#78A6A3"),
  ylim = c(0, 10),
  ylab = "My enjoyment (out of 10)",
  main = "My current reading mood",
  sub = "Source: my own reading preferences",
  las = 1,
  border = NA
)

text(
  x = bar_positions,
  y = reading_ratings,
  labels = reading_ratings,
  pos = 3
)
```
